t: You're on Wood Lane, which runs north from Shepherd's Bush, under the Westway, past Wormwood Scrubs to where it meets Scrubs Lane. It lies wholly within Hammersmith and Fulham, and it's probably best known as the home of BBC Television Centre. It also has a much older connection: Dru Drury, the entomologist, was born here. He collected natural history specimens sent by ship's officers from across the world, and other entomologists used his collections to name new species. His book, Illustrations of Natural History, appeared in parts between 1770 and 1782.
